## Design

### 2026-10-06 — Just completed the Schematic design!

**2h**

Just completed the Schematic design!
As I am  totally new in this kind of projects, I tried to follow the StarKingStudios Starbie guide that was provided and also took some online tutorials on using KiCad.

![esp32-schematic](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6GB1YqChc2GAWs62a6rWVrE8XcY5mv9P/bf9d1df9e524d9e96cd5e54a85925c006a5c4ac1bb7d605119def2c04057d0a2.jpg)
First of all I am using mainly 4 parts to build the  Starbie.
    1. The ESP32 C3 as the microcontroller .
   2. 2 buttons to enable some interaction with the pet.
   3. The DHT11 sensor, so that our Starbie can sense temperature.
   4. A screen to display our character .
By the way, it took me longer than it should've to complete the schematic due to some software crashes
because computer is quite old and weak, I don't know how much it will be able to handle.
At first I got very confused by the net element/components whatever you call it , so i took some some tutorials online . Later on I also ran into some issues assigning the footprints because i couldn't find the right footprints so I asked Gemini about it and finally i found out that I hadn't imported the required footprints yet that was provided by the StarKingStudios repo.
Overall the work season was fun and informative also.
Next I'm going to work on the main PCB...(Actually my English is not good so my kind request to the reader that please consider and try to get the closest meaning )
